title: West Bursey Ranch: what to verify before a move
summary: A careful Keller-area guide focused on address-level school checks, current property documents and questions to ask before listing or buying.

sections.heading: Treat the subdivision name as a starting point, not a property record
paragraphs: A subdivision label alone does not confirm a home’s boundaries, current services, deed restrictions, association status or fees. For a specific property, review current recorded and seller-provided documents and confirm material questions with the relevant source.
sections.statusNote: No subdivision-specific HOA fee or restriction is verified in this guide.

sections.heading: Confirm school assignment for the exact address
paragraphs: Use Keller ISD’s official address resources for the property and school year under consideration. This guide does not promise enrollment, eligibility, boundary placement or a particular campus.

sections.heading: Compare a commute using your own trip details
paragraphs: Choose the actual destination, route mode and departure window when checking travel. Regional commute statistics describe populations and are not a rush-hour travel estimate from a particular home.

evidence.title: City of Keller official website
evidence.scope: Official municipal entry point; not evidence of subdivision-level covenants or HOA terms.

evidence.title: Keller ISD maps and address resources
evidence.scope: District map/address lookup; verify the specific property's current assignment directly.

evidence.title: ACS commuting guidance
evidence.scope: Regional commuting context is not a property-specific drive-time calculation.
